correctness.rationale: Opposite nonzero update signs are necessary for a nontrivial two-step position return. Solving the resulting two momentum equations gives the exact interval \(\beta\delta/(1+\beta)<u<\delta/(1+\beta)\) and unique momentum pair. The local two-step map fixes the position and multiplies deviation from the invariant momentum graph by \(\beta^2\), so the family is normally attracting with tangential multiplier one and no individual cycle is asymptotically stable.

value.rationale: Signed updates impose a nonvanishing step near a minimizer, making persistent oscillation a natural structural question. The exact family shows that momentum narrows center bias but cannot reduce the \(\delta/2\) oscillation half-amplitude, while its normal contraction simultaneously slows to \(\beta^2\). The neutral tangent direction also corrects the misleading expectation of an isolated stable limit cycle.
